title: 手書きのひつじと未年素材
subject: ひつじ
subject_en: the SAME loosely hand-drawn sheep character: a round cloud-shaped woolly body in warm cream (#FFF6E0, never pure white), a small oval face in soft beige with dot eyes and a tiny smile, two little curled horns, stubby dark-grey legs. Outline is a closed, slightly wobbly dark-grey line all around; no shading.
lead: 2027年の干支、ひつじのお正月素材12点です。年賀状、LINEの新年あいさつ、1月のおたよりに使えます。
